title: Geometry-physics confounding impairs PDE learning across varying domains
abstract: arXiv:2609.38623v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Learning partial differential equation (PDE) dynamics across varying domains is central to predictive modelling and data-driven discovery of governing equations. However, geometric variation alters both field representation and the governing differential operators, confounding geometric effects with intrinsic physical properties in the observed dynamics. This work identifies geometry-physics confounding as a unified failure mechanism for PDE learning across varying domains. In forward operator learning, this confounding increases the burden of inferring geometry-dependent operator changes from finite data, reducing data efficiency and generalisation. In equation discovery, omitting geometry-induced operators misspecifies the candidate library, leading to biased parameters, missed governing terms and spurious terms. We propose a de-confounding framework that makes the known geometry-to-operator transformation explicit. Geometry-induced co

translated_title: 几何-物理混淆阻碍了跨变化域的偏微分方程学习
translated_abstract: 在变化域上学习偏微分方程（PDE）动力学是预测建模和数据驱动控制方程发现的核心。然而，几何变化会同时改变场的表示和控制微分算子，导致观测动力学中几何效应与内在物理属性相互混淆。本工作将几何-物理混淆识别为跨变化域PDE学习的统一失败机制。在前向算子学习中，这种混淆增加了从有限数据中推断几何相关算子变化的负担，降低了数据效率和泛化能力。在方程发现中，忽略几何诱导的算子会导致候选函数库的误设，从而产生有偏的参数、遗漏的控制项和虚假的项。我们提出了一个去混淆框架，将已知的几何到算子的变换显式化。几何诱导的……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文指出几何变化与物理属性的混淆是跨变化域PDE学习的统一失败机制，并提出通过显式建模已知的几何到算子变换的去混淆框架，以提升算子学习的数据效率与泛化能力以及方程发现的准确性。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies geometry-physics confounding as a unified failure mechanism for PDE learning across varying domains, and proposes a de-confounding framework that explicitly incorporates the known geometry-to-operator transformation to improve operator learning and equation discovery.
